import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sleep_disorder_order = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts().index.tolist()
for disorder in sleep_disorder_order:
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]
        label = 'None'
    else:
        subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=80, label=label, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Physical Activity Level vs Stress Level by BMI Category
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
bmi_categories = df['BMI Category'].unique()
bmi_colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c', 'Normal Weight': '#27ae60'}
for bmi in bmi_categories:
    if pd.notna(bmi):
        subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
        color = bmi_colors.get(bmi, '#95a5a6')
        ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
                   alpha=0.6, s=80, label=bmi, color=color, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Average Sleep Duration and Quality by Occupation (Top 10)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
occupation_stats = occupation_stats.nlargest(10, 'Sleep Duration')

x = np.arange(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.35

bars1 = ax3.barh(x - width/2, occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], width, 
                 label='Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1)
bars2 = ax3.barh(x + width/2, occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep'], width, 
                 label='Quality of Sleep', color='#9b59b6', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1)

ax3.set_yticks(x)
ax3.set_yticklabels(occupation_stats['Occupation'], fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Value', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Top 10 Occupations by Sleep Duration & Quality', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(loc='lower right', framealpha=0.9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='x')

# 4. Distribution of Daily Steps by Sleep Disorder
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sleep_disorders = []
daily_steps = []
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        steps = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].isna()]['Daily Steps'].values
        sleep_disorders.append('None')
    else:
        steps = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]['Daily Steps'].values
        sleep_disorders.append(disorder)
    daily_steps.append(steps)

bp = ax4.boxplot(daily_steps, labels=sleep_disorders, patch_artist=True, 
                 notch=True, showmeans=True, meanline=True,
                 boxprops=dict(facecolor='#3498db', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5),
                 whiskerprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=1.5),
                 capprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=1.5),
                 medianprops=dict(color='#e74c3c', linewidth=2),
                 meanprops=dict(color='#f39c12', linewidth=2, linestyle='--'))

ax4.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
